profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ LinkedIn | Front-End (React, TypeScript, Ember) | Accessibility, Performance & AI-Assisted Dev Tooling | Full-Stack with Node.js
profile.summary:
I'm a Staff Software Engineer on LinkedIn's Marketing Solutions team, building Campaign Manager, the platform advertisers use to reach professionals worldwide. I've spent 13 years in front-end, from TV set-top apps to ad-tech at scale.

Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Ember, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, HTML/CSS, Vite, Redux Toolkit

What I do best:
- Own large front-end initiatives end to end: RFC, design doc, launch, adoption
- Build config-driven, reusable UI platforms that let teams ship new behavior with minimal code
- Raise the bar on accessibility, performance and compliance (GDPR, DMA, DSA)
- Use AI tooling to multiply team velocity, and step into full-stack when the work calls for it

Currently building NutriTrail, a full-stack TypeScript/Node/Postgres side project.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front-end lead for audience and targeting products in LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
- Led front-end for the Predictive and Nurture Audiences. Built a config-driven platform that allows rapid feature additions and support for new advertising signals for retargeting. 
- Drove adoption across the audience portfolio: Auto-Targeting +37% and Accelerate +25% activation, Accelerate Audience Signals at 100% rollout, and a customer-driven unarchive feature that cut ~170 support cases per quarter
- Compliance point of contact for targeting flows (DMA, DSA, GDPR); built a reusable legal-disclaimer framework to handle various regional compliance needs.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led front-end architecture for Audience Hub, making audiences a first-class workflow in Campaign Manager. Authored the RFC and design doc and set a multi-quarter roadmap
- Shipped Saved Audiences, Audience Sharing, Engagement Retargeting and Company Matching, partnering with Product, UX, Legal and backend
- Converted the Matched Audiences page into a reusable component instead of rewriting it, enabling a smooth migration with less duplicate code
- Shipped ATT compliance changes under a tight deadline with changes across the product features to align with ATT

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built targeting features for Campaign Manager's objective-based buying, migrating to the modern Ember stack with keyboard navigation and accessibility support
- Led UI for Global Templates from design doc to launch; adopted by 5–10% of new campaigns
- Shipped Create Lookalike Audience, a top advertiser request, on a tight deadline
- Owned accessibility, CI and event tracking for the targeting module with 100% meaningful test coverage

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led UI development for ONE by AOL, an ad-tech platform
- Designed core JavaScript libraries and frameworks; drove performance optimization and code/architecture reviews

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Authored adapt-strap, an open-source AngularJS UI component library used across the organization
- Built analytics and data-visualization dashboards (AngularJS, SVG, D3); ran web development training workshops

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Solo-built music web app: Backbone/Require front-end, Node.js/Express/MongoDB REST API, OAuth2 (Passport.js), Android/iOS apps via PhoneGap.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Intern)
positions.locationName: EXDG (entertainment experience development group) San Jose, California
positions.description: Built high-performance HTML5/JavaScript apps and pixel-perfect video-control UIs for TV, Blu-ray and PlayStation, tuning memory use and rendering on low-power devices.

projects.title: CourseQuest
projects.description: A simple website which aggregates online courses from independent services such as Coursera, Canvas, EdX, etcetera.

projects.title: Undergraduate Studies (SJSU)
projects.description: Enhancing the SJSU UGS website with new features and a dashboard.
